records.text: Spencer Cox announced that he appointed Representative Tyler Clancy as Utah's state homeless coordinator and thanked outgoing coordinator Wayne Niederhauser for his service and congratulated him on retirement.
records.speaker: Spencer Cox

appearances.snippet: Here's what it says. Today, I appointed Rep. Tyler Clancy as Utah State's homeless coordinator. I'm confident in his leadership to deliver results, faster help for those who need it, and cleaner, safer streets. ... Thank you to Wayne Niederhauser, our outgoing state homeless coordinator, for his service and congratulations on his retirement
